scripts.dev:server: npm run build:packages && npm --prefix server run dev
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm --prefix web run dev
scripts.build:packages: npm --prefix packages/shared-types run build && npm --prefix packages/track-core run build
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.release:build: npm run build && npm run release:check
scripts.release:start: npm run release:build && npm run start
